checkpoint.title: Mt. Moon: a Moon Stone, a Rocket, Miguel and the Helix Fossil
notes: Mt. Moon (pokefirered data/maps/MtMoon_1F, _B1F, _B2F). Every floor tile of the cave has wild encounters, which are run from, so its legs end on walls, ladders or someone standing still, which the walker holds again after a battle; the few open ones are short. The way through: up 1F's middle and west side, its north-west ladder, B1F's west ladder down to B2F's south-east, round B2F's south edge to its west, north past Miguel and the fossils, and the ladder up to B1F's east end, which leads out to Route 4 east of the mountain.

- 1F's trainers are walked around: Youngster Josh (13, 17) sees east along row 17 to x 17, so the way west into the west room is down column 18 and up column 11; Lass Miriam walks round (32..33, 4..5), sight 2, so the way east keeps to row 9 and columns 38 and 40; Hiker Marcos wanders (5..9, 8..12) and sees one tile, so the way north is column 11 and row 3.
- The Moon Stone ball (3, 2) on 1F (FLAG_HIDE_MT_MOON_1F_MOON_STONE) is a few tiles off the way to the ladder (5, 6).

- The Grunt at (37, 21) on B2F looks around (sight 3) over the only way east round B2F. His room is crossed on legs to walls, at one tile of his sight each, (37, 22) and (40, 21); if he looks the player's way, he walks up beside the leg, story_interrupts() fights him, and the leg is held on to its wall.
- The Grunt at (12, 20) faces south (sight 2) over (12, 21..22), across rows 21..22, the only way north to Miguel: stepped into from the west, he is next to the player and doesn't walk.
- Super Nerd Miguel (13, 11) battles on the step onto (14, 11) (MtMoon_B2F_EventScript_MiguelTrigger, VAR_MAP_SCENE_MT_MOON_B2F 0), then "We'll each take one!"

- The fossils: DOME (13, 7), HELIX (14, 7). After the HELIX, Miguel walks up to (13, 8) and takes the DOME, which opens the gap north. The save is on Route 4: the save card's places don't include Mt. Moon.
